messages:
clara: Heads-up 1 — Cobalt Health signed a 24-month Dedicated renewal and we shipped their ISV listing on Azure Marketplace today. Listing: https://azuremarketplace.microsoft.com/listings/cobalt-redwood. Big win for our private-deploy strategy. :tada:

jason: Incredible! Renewal terms: committed GPUs, 99.95% SLA, and a 30% commitment discount. They'll migrate 6 services over the next quarter.

azure-marketplace-bot: Azure Marketplace listing published (Offer ID: COBALT-RW-2026). Private Offer available 1 PO ID: AZ-PO-432198.

rachel: Legal approved the case study text and the redlined PO yesterday. Data residency clause confirmed for EMEA nodes. Cobalt signed off on the quote.

marta: Assets uploaded: https://drive.redwood.internal/partners/cobalt-health-azure (case-study-draft.pdf, architecture-diagram.png, customer-quote.txt). Planning a co-hosted webinar with Cobalt ENG next month.

marketing-bot: Draft blog post created in CMS: "Cobalt Health scales clinical-NLP inference with Redwood Dedicated via Azure Marketplace". Assigned to clara for final review (due: 2026-04-07).

support: Quick note for oncall: Cobalt requested custom KV-cache tuning and a dedicated burst policy. Eng-runtime, please prioritize the tuning runbook so SREs can onboard smoothly.

jason: Can product add a short how-to for Marketplace + Dedicated in docs? 4 bullets would be perfect for customers replicating this setup.

marta: Yep 1 will coordinate with eng-docs. Also requested a console banner for Monday to highlight "Now available on Azure Marketplace".

clara: Metrics from day 0: listing impressions: 18, private-offer inquiries: 2, trial starts: 1. Cobalt reported preliminary perf: 2.6x throughput and 22% tail-latency reduction vs.
their prior infra.

rachel: Approved public quote: "Working with Redwood reduced our inference costs and made capacity predictable during peaks." Cobalt OK'd it.

marketing-bot: Social assets ready in Drive under /assets/cobalt_health. Suggested tweet + LinkedIn copy saved. Will queue for Tuesday.

clara: Thanks team 1 big milestone for Azure Marketplace adoption. If anyone has follow-ups for the PO or assets, DM me. We'll post the public case study after final copy edits. :rocket:
